transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because I keep avoiding my own workshop, and family get-togethers if my brother-in-law might be there. I’m tired of arranging my life around not running into those reminders.
What happened involving your workshop or your brother-in-law that these situations remind you of?
I’m not sure I can point to one particular thing that happened. I just know I’ve started staying away from those places and from him.
What do you fear might happen if you go into your workshop or find yourself around your brother-in-law?

I don’t know that I fear one specific thing happening. It’s more that being in the workshop, or seeing him at a family gathering, brings up reminders I’d rather not deal with. So I steer clear, but I’m tired of planning everything around avoiding them.
Do you ever have unwanted, distressing memories about what happened pop into your head when you don't want them to?
Yes. Out of nowhere I’ll see his hand holding that heavy tool again, like a picture in my head—when I’m shaving or working on a painting. It still makes my chest tighten.
How long have you been experiencing these distressing memories and the urge to avoid things?
Since that confrontation with my brother-in-law—about two years and four months now.
